problems.problem_text: Find the perimeter of a rectangle with length 8 cm and width 5 cm.
Find the perimeter of a square with side length 6 cm.
A triangle has sides of lengths 7 cm, 5 cm, and 9 cm. Find its perimeter.
Find the circumference of a circle with radius 7 cm (use pi = 22/7).
problems.solution: C = 2 x pi x r = 2 x (22/7) x 7 = 44 cm

problems.problem_text: A rectangle has perimeter 34 cm and length 12 cm. Find its width.
A regular hexagon has perimeter 48 cm. Find the length of one side.
problems.solution: A regular hexagon has 6 equal sides. s = 48 / 6 = 8 cm

problems.problem_text: Find the circumference of a circle with diameter 14 cm (use pi = 22/7).
Find the perimeter of a semicircle with radius 7 cm including the diameter edge (use pi = 22/7).
problems.solution: Arc = pi x r = (22/7) x 7 = 22 cm. Diameter = 14 cm. Total = 22 + 14 = 36 cm

problems.problem_text: An L-shape has sides: 10 m, 6 m, 4 m, 3 m, 6 m, and 3 m. Find its perimeter.
A circular wheel has radius 35 cm. How far does it travel in 100 complete rotations? (use pi = 22/7, answer in metres)
problems.solution: C = 2 x (22/7) x 35 = 220 cm per rotation. Distance = 220 x 100 = 22,000 cm = 220 m

problems.problem_text: A triangle has perimeter 30 cm. Two sides are 11 cm and 8 cm. Find the third side.
A regular octagon has side length 4.5 cm. Find its perimeter.
A rectangle has length (3x + 2) cm and width (x + 1) cm. Find an expression for its perimeter.
A shape consists of a rectangle 12 cm by 8 cm with a semicircle (radius 4 cm) on one of the longer sides. Find the total perimeter (use pi = 3.142).
problems.solution: Rectangle contributes 12 + 8 + 8 = 28 cm (one long side replaced by semicircle). Arc = pi x 4 = 12.568 cm. Plus other long side 12 cm. Wait: the semicircle replaces one 12 cm side. So P = 8 + 8 + 12 + (pi x 4) = 28 + 12.568 = 40.568 cm. Hmm, let me recalculate. The shape: rectangle 12 x 8. Semicircle on one 12 cm side (radius 6 cm). P = 12 + 8 + 8 + (pi x 6) = 28 + 18.852 = 46.852 cm. Let me use r=4 cm semicircle on one 8 cm side. P = 12 + 12 + 8 + (pi x 4) = 32 + 12.568 = 44.568 cm approx.

problems.problem_text: A sector of a circle has radius 10 cm and arc length 15.71 cm. Find the angle of the sector in degrees (use pi = 3.142).
problems.solution: Arc = (theta/360) x 2 x pi x r. 15.71 = (theta/360) x 62.84. theta/360 = 0.25. theta = 90 degrees.

problems.problem_text: A shape consists of a square of side (x+3) cm and an equilateral triangle of side x cm sharing a side. Find the total perimeter in terms of x.
problems.solution: Square contributes 3 sides: 3(x+3). Triangle contributes 2 sides: 2x. Shared side not counted. Total = 3x+9+2x = 5x+9.
